name: DiscoveryAgent
description: Mandatory gateway step for every QA workflow. Runs DOM scan and/or BRD comprehension depending on project.yaml inputs (url/brd_dir), and blocks the workflow if mandatory outputs are missing. Phase 1: requirements extracted from a DOM-synthesised BRD (URL-only mode) are marked source dom_inferred. Phase 2 (discovery.deep): batched deep element capture (frames, shadow DOM, custom widgets, constraints, container-scoped locators) of the module page, plus a project-level multi-role crawl writing app_map / form_model / api_inventory / permission_matrix / baseline (never blocking).

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Target application URL; triggers DOM scan

inputs.name: brd_dir
inputs.description: Path to BRD document or directory; triggers BRD comprehension

inputs.name: discovery
inputs.description: Resolved `discovery:` block of project.yaml (deep, max_pages, max_depth, max_minutes, validation, …); deep=false keeps the legacy scanner

inputs.name: safety
inputs.description: Resolved safety policy; its allowed_hosts bound which frames are extracted and which URLs the crawl visits

inputs.name: force_recrawl
inputs.description: --force-recrawl: run the deep pass even if a fresh app_map.json could be reused

outputs.name: deep_discovery
outputs.description: Phase 2 deep pass summary: status (success|reused|disabled|skipped|failed), states, forms, probes, endpoints, roles, stopped_by, paths

outputs.name: dom_scan_stats
outputs.description: Phase 2 deep-scan stats of the module page (duration, frames, shadow roots, scoped locators, limitations)
